diagnostics.message: Satellite block flash_pullups attaches to satellite block flash; flatten it into one satellite block and use islands/clusters for internal structure

Passive block usb_power_or has no parent or external placement relation, so board packing may place it in any free area. Make it a satellite with placement: "satellite", attachTo, and preferably anchor: pin(...), or add an external near(), veryNear(), or criticalPair() using comp()/pin() targets.
